description: This file implements security policy checks for Kubernetes pods, specifically enforcing that containers run as non-root users. It defines functions to verify the 'runAsNonRoot' security context at both pod and container levels, supporting different Kubernetes versions.

methods.name: CheckRunAsNonRoot
methods.description: Returns a security check object for verifying 'runAsNonRoot' compliance across Kubernetes versions.

methods.name: runAsNonRoot1_35
methods.description: Checks if the pod complies with 'runAsNonRoot' policy in Kubernetes 1.35+, considering user namespace relaxation.

methods.name: runAsNonRoot1_0
methods.description: Checks if the pod complies with 'runAsNonRoot' policy in Kubernetes 1.0, verifying security contexts at pod and container levels.
